stops.name: Fichtelgebirge
stops.detail: Snow is guaranteed from December to the end of March on the heights of the Fichtelgebirge mountains. Around Mount Ochsenkopf and Saubadfelsen, several hundred kilometres of trails and cross-country tracks await cross-country skiers, tourers and snowshoe hikers in addition to four kilometres of pistes. Text and photos: Thomas Linkel
